# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven or eight years old during Anne's time teaching in Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c10 P86](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0086)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is a small, rather cute boy with a dark, sullen little face. He has black eyes that sparkle with curiosity and mockery.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P29](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0029)_

## Personality

Anthony is an independent, sullen, and mischievous boy who is given to impertinent behavior toward those he does not respect. He holds a strong prejudice against female teachers, believing them to be no good, and initially treats Anne Shirley with a scornful air of toleration. However, he is capable of showing respect once he believes a teacher can enforce discipline, and ultimately proves to be a lad who can be won over by firmness.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## History

Anthony Pye came to Avonlea as an orphan to live with his aunt and uncle, Mr. and Mrs. George Pye, and entered the Avonlea school under Anne Shirley. Holding a firm belief that girl teachers were useless, he treated Anne with open scorn and disdained her attempts to win him over with kindness. During Anne's first year of teaching, he engaged in various acts of mischief, such as pouring water down a classmate's neck and putting a live mouse in Anne's desk drawer. After he insolently confessed to the mouse prank, an exasperated Anne lost her temper and whipped him with her pointer. To Anne's surprise, this punishment earned her his respect, as he considered it 'just as good as a man's.' From that point on, Anthony's attitude toward Anne improved significantly; he began carrying her books to school and acknowledged that she was 'some good after all.' When Anne resigned her post two years later, Anthony was deeply upset by the news and fought two battles with other boys to vent his feelings.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P31](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0031), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
